requirements.text: The app must provide real-time spending notifications for transactions.
The app must allow users to instantly freeze their card without talking to anyone.
The app must provide a monthly spending breakdown categorized by types of expenses.
The app must allow users to set a budget for each category and provide alerts when spending is close to the budget limit.
The app must display a consolidated view of all accounts (current account, savings, and credit card) on one screen.
The app must provide secure login options such as fingerprint or face recognition.
The app must ensure the user's data is protected and secure.
